Example Industries Inc Q4 2016 Earnings Call
SPRINGFIELD Feb 2, 2017 (Example Wire) -- Edited Transcript of Example Industries Inc earnings conference call
TEXT version of Transcript
================================================================================ Corporate Participants ================================================================================ * Dana Park Example Industries Inc - CEO * Lee Moran Example Industries Inc - CFO
================================================================================ Conference Call Participants ================================================================================ * Sam Ortiz Harbor Securities - Analyst
================================================================================ Presentation -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Operator [1] -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Good day and welcome to the Example Industries fourth quarter earnings call. Today's call is being recorded. -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Dana Park, Example Industries Inc - CEO [2] -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Thank you, and good morning. Before we start, our remarks include forward-looking statements, and actual results may differ materially from those described. Revenue grew 8% this quarter on strong demand for our pumps. Trade policy remains the main risk we see, and new taxes on imported steel could raise our costs. We have a plan to manage that risk with a second supplier. -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Lee Moran, Example Industries Inc - CFO [3] -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Gross margin improved to 34%. We expect government infrastructure spending to support orders next year, although the timing is uncertain. ================================================================================ Questions and Answers -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Operator [4] -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Our first question comes from Sam Ortiz with Harbor Securities. -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Sam Ortiz, Harbor Securities - Analyst [5] -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Thanks. How exposed are you if the trade war gets worse? -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Dana Park, Example Industries Inc - CEO [6] -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- About a fifth of our steel is imported. A broader trade war would be a real risk, but our risk management team has contracts in place through the summer. -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Sam Ortiz, Harbor Securities - Analyst [7] -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- And on taxes? -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Lee Moran, Example Industries Inc - CFO [8] -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- The new taxes would cost us about two cents a share. There is little politics in our guidance; we simply assume current rules hold. ================================================================================ Definitions -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- This synthetic transcript was written for tests and contains no real call text.
